Class Bytes

java.lang.Object
be.imgn.gaia.core.io.Bytes
All Implemented Interfaces:
Comparable<Bytes>
public final class Bytes extends Object implements Comparable<Bytes>
An immutable sequence of bytes, usable as a value: two instances with the same bytes are equal, and instances are ordered by their bytes.

Arrays given to the factory methods are copied, and arrays handed out are copies, so no one can change the bytes of an instance. A slice shares the bytes of the instance it comes from. 

var checksum = Bytes.encode(text).digest("SHA-256").toHex();
var frame = Bytes.build(out -> out.writeShort(type).writeInt(body.size()).write(body));
Since:
0.1.3

    • slice

      public Bytes slice(int fromIndex, int toIndex)
      Returns the bytes between two indexes. The slice shares the bytes of this instance instead of copying them, so a small slice keeps all of them in memory; Bytes.of(slice.toByteArray()) keeps only its own.
      Parameters:
      fromIndex - the index of the first byte, included
      toIndex - the index after the last byte, excluded
      Returns:
      the bytes from fromIndex to toIndex
      Throws:
      IndexOutOfBoundsException - if fromIndex is negative, greater than toIndex, or if toIndex is greater than the size

      public boolean equals(@Nullable Object object)
